assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated for continuous rhythm assessment
The service is to correlate the patient's palpitations and lightheadedness with the paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
